missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Центр' is the nominative predicate noun. 'Города' is the genitive of possession. 'Самый старый' forms the superlative. A descriptive statement.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Центр' is the accusative after 'в', showing destination; this inanimate masculine noun keeps the nominative form. A common trip phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В центре' uses the prepositional form 'центре' after 'в' to show location. 'Города' is genitive. A residence statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Центра' is the genitive after 'от', marking the starting point. 'Пешком' is an adverb of manner. A directions phrase.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К центру' uses the dative 'центру' after 'к' to show movement toward. 'Дорога' is the nominative subject. A navigation phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 'Центром' is the instrumental after 'перед', showing relative position. 'Площадь' is the nominative subject. A spatial description.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Центров' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. 'Торговых' agrees in the plural genitive. A factual statement.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Центры' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'По выходным' is dative plural of recurrence. A schedule statement.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 'Центрами' is the instrumental plural after 'между'. 'Парк' is the nominative subject of 'есть'. A spatial description.

missions.phrase: Я был во всех центрах города.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Центрах' is the prepositional plural after 'во'. 'Всех' agrees in the plural. A summary of visits.
